svg.aria-label: B flat major scale over two octaves on the treble staff with fingerings, and the first-position hand shape on each string; fingers that play B flat or E flat drop a half-step toward the nut
svg.text: B♭ major, two octaves: which fingers drop
Key signature B♭ and E♭. The finger for each flat note sits a half-step nearer the nut.
The hand shape on each string (1st position, nut on the left)
red = a flat note (B♭ or E♭)
dashed = where that finger goes for B♮ or E♮
From Chapter 1 of this post. E♭5 on the A string also needs the 4th finger, since the open E is E♮.
